description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [50% Critical (25s)], [Attach Poison with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Captain's Fury Mode I (Leila - Poison)], [Awoken Poison Cloud XVI] and [Poison Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Captain's Fury Mode I (Leila - Poison)
description.text: Poison abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Poison abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Poison abilities

description.name: Awoken Poison Cloud XVI
description.text: Keeps track of the number of Poison abilities used (0~5), grants [Awoken Poison Cloud XVI Critical] to the user after using a Poison ability

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Captain's Fury Mode II (Leila - Poison)], removes [Dual Awoken Captain's Fury Mode I (Leila - Poison)]
